title: antirrhinum sempervirens subsp. densiflorum
intro: Antirrhinum sempervirens subsp. densiflorum, commonly known as the white snapdragon or white flowering snapdragon, is a flowering plant that belongs to the snapdragon family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects that help soothe and calm the skin, reducing the risk of infections and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Antirrhinum sempervirens subsp. densiflorum include its ability to relax the muscles, reduce fever, and ease respiratory issues such as coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
